functions.name: buffAlloc1
functions.purpose: Allocate a byte buffer and initialize its capacity and position.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: No floating-point arithmetic.

functions.name: buffRealloc1
functions.purpose: Resize a buffer and clamp its position to the new capacity.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: No floating-point arithmetic.

functions.name: buffFree1
functions.purpose: Free a buffer and its byte storage.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: No floating-point arithmetic.

functions.name: buffAlloc2
functions.purpose: Allocate an array of independently allocated byte buffers.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: No floating-point arithmetic.

functions.name: buffFree2
functions.purpose: Free an array of buffers and the array itself.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: No floating-point arithmetic.

functions.name: wpc1Compress
functions.signature: void *wpc1Compress(float *f, int n1, float error, int *nbytes);
functions.purpose: Tile, transform, quantize, and encode a seismic trace into a compressed object.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Results depend on transform, quantization, and encoding arithmetic; regular blocks may be transformed in place. The realloc result is assigned to a local pointer rather than back to wpc1->code, so a moved allocation leaves a stale pointer.

functions.name: wpc1Uncompress
functions.purpose: Decode and reconstruct a compressed seismic trace, returning a consistency flag.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Reconstruction depends on dequantization and inverse-transform arithmetic and the original block and padding decisions.

functions.name: wpc1Numsmp
functions.purpose: Return the number of samples in a compressed trace.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: No floating-point arithmetic.

functions.name: wpc1Size
functions.purpose: Return the length of the compressed byte stream.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: No floating-point arithmetic.

functions.name: wpc1Free
functions.purpose: Free a compressed trace and its byte stream.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: No floating-point arithmetic.

functions.name: wpc1Write
functions.purpose: Write a compressed trace header and byte stream to a file.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Writes native int and float representations, so the file format depends on sizes, byte order, and floating-point representation.

functions.name: wpc1Read
functions.purpose: Read a compressed trace header and byte stream from a file.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Reads native int and float representations; the payload read is not checked for completeness.

functions.name: wpc1Encoder
functions.purpose: Encode block quantization parameters and entropy-code their integer coefficients.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Finds float maxima and scales steps and averages to 16-bit integers; double constants and NINT rounding affect quantization boundaries. buffPutc is a macro.

functions.name: wpc1Decoder
functions.purpose: Decode block quantization parameters and entropy-coded integer coefficients.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Reconstructs float steps and averages from 16-bit integers using double constants; preserve conversion and rounding behavior. buffGetc is a macro.

functions.name: entCoder
functions.purpose: Write per-block bit widths and encode each block using its corresponding codebook.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Integer bitstream operations only; bitInitbuff, bitOutputbits, bitWindbuff, and bitFreebuff are macros, and the static dictionary builder supplies the codebooks.

functions.name: entDecoder
functions.purpose: Read per-block bit widths and decode each block using its corresponding codebook.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Integer bitstream operations only; bitInitbuff, bitInputbits, and bitFreebuff are macros, and the static dictionary builder supplies the codebooks.

functions.name: bookCoder
functions.signature: void bookCoder(void *buff, void *book, void *q, int numsmp);
functions.purpose: Encode integer symbols as codebook prefixes, signed magnitudes, zero runs, and an end marker.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Integer bitstream operations only; bitOutputbits is a macro. Preserve shift widths, sign encoding, and codebook lookup behavior.

functions.name: bookDecoder
functions.signature: int bookDecoder(void *bbuff, void *book, void *q, int numsmp);
functions.purpose: Decode codebook prefixes, signed magnitudes, and zero runs into integer symbols.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Integer bitstream operations only; bitInputbits is a macro. Preserve prefix interpretation, end-of-block checks, and shift behavior.

functions.name: wpc1Quant
functions.signature: void wpc1Quant(float *x, int n, float error, void *inconf, void *qstate);
functions.purpose: Quantize a transformed block or raw samples using an RMS-error-based step.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Float sums and squared deviations are order-sensitive; sqrt promotes to double, constants mix float and double, and the iterative bit-limit adjustment and NINT rounding affect discrete output. It modifies x while removing the average.

functions.name: wpc1Dequant
functions.signature: void wpc1Dequant(float *x, int n, void *inconf, void *qstate);
functions.purpose: Reconstruct floating-point samples or coefficients from quantized integers and their stored average.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: The reciprocal uses a double literal before assignment to float; preserve the FLT_MIN branch, float multiplication, and average-addition order.

functions.name: wpc1Trans
functions.purpose: Apply a configured forward or inverse wavelet packet transform to a block in place.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Numerical behavior is determined by wavePack1 and the configured float filter coefficients.

functions.name: wavePack1
functions.signature:
void wavePack1(float *x, float *y, waveFILTER *filter, 
	int twopow, int stage, int type);
functions.purpose: Decompose or reconstruct a signal through staged wavelet packet filtering.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Nested float convolution and reconstruction accumulations are order-sensitive; preserve paired multiply-add grouping, stage ordering, circular index masks, and coefficient precision.
